_comment: Human-readable restatement of what is frozen for the dev-c7 qwen re-registered pass (runs/dev-c7-qwen-r2/PREREGISTRATION.md). NOT the runner's manifest.json, which is compared with this file after the run; any frozen value that differs is reported as a deviation. Hash formats as in runs/dev-c7/manifest-template.json. Fields copied from the dev-c7 template are unchanged; null fields are filled after the run.

registration.relation_to_dev_c7_qwen: a new, separately registered pass of the same qwen configuration; the 5-case partial dev-c7 qwen run stays in the record unchanged and is not replaced, rerun or rescored

frozen_src_tree_check: git ls-tree -r HEAD tools/media-repair-harness/src | sha1sum = 36a08be3d70027533f56d41250edc940053e31df, and git diff cc539654 HEAD -- tools/media-repair-harness/src empty; checked before the first call and after the last. Equal to the dev-c7 Amendment 1 commit 1419f4b7 and to main cc539654

options.started_aborted_scoring: not scored; listed unscored (started-aborted/<case>.json). Each gate keeps score.py's own denominator; G7 uses planned cases. Recorded, started-aborted and never-started counts are reported next to every gate.
options.spend_limit: uncapped (--no-spend-limit; config.spend_limit); the 2700 s wall cap stays

subsets: (b) neither a reported-count nor the estimate flag
context_policy.sizing: context-sizing.json: max estimate 15970 incl. the 640 reserve at 8192 (0 of 383 at or over 16384), 14833 at 4096; 0 of 73 first messages paginated at 8192, 28 at 4096
context_policy.repair_turns: the sizing has no repair turn; a repair adds the invalid reply (up to 640 tokens, num_predict) and a repair message; the reported-count flags (prompt_reaches_input_budget, reported_prompt_did_not_grow) catch any truncation that results

gpu_safety.offline: gpu-fit-offline.json: expected to fit fully (assumed qwen35 layout 20142 MiB of 24124 MiB free; conservative bound 23214 MiB); an estimate, never an authorisation; computed from 0.40.6 metadata and an assumed layout, so it says nothing specific about 0.40.7
gpu_safety.runtime_check: full-gpu-v2 (Amendment 1; was full-gpu-v1): one /api/ps read after the warm-up AND after every case call that reports a reload (load_duration above 1 s, or none reported); full GPU = only this model resident, size_vram == size, context_length (if reported) >= 16384; at the warm-up anything else unloads and skips (exit 3, gpu_fit_skip (full-gpu-v2), no case call); at a reload it aborts (exit 3, gpu_fit_abort; the case started-aborted, unscored), unloads, no retry. Amendment 2: a reload is detected only after the call that reloaded, so that one call (at most 120 s) may have run partly on the CPU; the run aborts at the first detected split, at most one call per run can be affected, and an eviction in the middle of a call cannot be prevented
gpu_safety.declare_activity: dev-c7 qwen r2, scope ai,ollama-prime, ttl 60m
gpu_safety.recorded_on_0_40_6: dev-c7 warm-up at num_ctx 16384 on 0.40.6: 100% GPU, size = size_vram = 17361985862 bytes, context_length 16384 (a fact about 0.40.6, not a prediction for 0.40.7)

runtime.helmrelease: haynes-ops kubernetes/main/apps/ai/ollama/prime/app/helmrelease.yaml, image docker.io/ollama/ollama tag 0.40.7 since 91bd893c (haynes-ops #4158, Renovate, merged 2026-10-21T04:35:22Z; changed only the tag); blob 7c48b0a359acf827c7685455309d84e9d555b1d1 at haynes-ops origin/main 1c514a7b
runtime.pod_at_registration: ollama-prime-cdc6fb897-jnkjp, started 2026-10-21T04:39:14Z, image docker.io/ollama/ollama:0.40.7, imageID docker.io/ollama/ollama@sha256:2e6cc92ffa43b4b1a2e70e315407e00ac97ec125afc71277d73c7efe01c4f31b, restarts 0, ready (Kubernetes API read at 2026-10-21T11:10:11Z; no Ollama endpoint called)
runtime.pre_run_check: before declare-activity, with no Ollama call: the HelmRelease tag on haynes-ops origin/main is 0.40.7 and the running app container image is docker.io/ollama/ollama:0.40.7 with the imageID above, restarts 0, and no open haynes-ops PR changes the ollama-prime image. If the tag or the image differs, the pass is not started and the coordinator is told (another runtime needs a new registration). If such a PR is open, the pass is not started and the coordinator is told; nothing was loaded, so a later start is not a rerun
runtime.post_run_record: manifest.runtime_version (from /api/version at preflight) must be 0.40.7, else a deviation reported in every table; the pod name, uid, container id and restart count after the run are recorded (the PSI/restart guard aborts the pass if any of them changes during it)
runtime.confound: new: dev-c4, dev-c5, dev-c6 and the partial dev-c7 qwen run all ran on Ollama 0.40.6; the dev-c7 Haiku and Astra runs use no Ollama but were measured on a different day and serving state

model_digest.offline_reread: manifest.model_digest of devc4-v4g-qwen3.8-27b (2026-10-20T05:36Z), devc5-b-qwen3.8-27b (2026-10-20T20:23Z), devc6-qwen3.8-27b (2026-10-21T00:19Z) and devc7-qwen3.8-27b (preflight 2026-10-21T04:38Z), all on Ollama 0.40.6, installed size 17741872154 bytes in every one
model_digest.not_confirmable_offline: no /api/tags reading from the 0.40.7 server is recorded; the upgrade changed only the image tag (same OLLAMA_MODELS store), so the installed model is expected to be unchanged, but that is not a confirmation
model_digest.runtime_confirmation: --require-digest at the runner preflight, after /api/version and /api/tags and before anything is loaded; a mismatch aborts with exit 3 (model digest differs from the frozen one ... nothing was loaded): the pass is SKIPPED and recorded, with no load, no case call, no pull and no rerun

retry_repair.model_call_failure: recorded with its receipt, forced escalate, no retry, the run continues
retry_repair.skips_and_aborts: busy /api/ps, a digest mismatch or a GPU-fit skip skips; a load failure, a reload that is not 100% GPU, a PSI/restart guard trip (pod replaced or restarted), an unreadable /api/ps or the wall cap aborts; none is repeated

run.run_id_reason: a new, separately registered pass needs its own identity; not devc7-qwen3.8-27b-r2, which dev-c7 section 5 reserves for a same-command preflight retry of Haiku or Astra
run.expected_config_hash_note: equal to dev-c7 qwen (612a2325...): the config records no path, run id or Ollama runtime version, and src, prompt and flags are unchanged. r2 is told apart from the partial dev-c7 qwen run by run_id, runtime_version, started_at and harness_git.sha
run.model_case_alias: case-<8 hex> = HMAC-SHA256(run id, case id) (leakguard.alias): a new run id gives new aliases, as between every earlier pair of runs; the alias is the only model-visible text that differs from the dev-c7 qwen command
run.declare_activity: declare-activity start "dev-c7 qwen r2" --scope ai,ollama-prime --ttl 60m; end with declare-activity end <id>

partial_dev_c7_qwen_run.status: stays in the record unchanged; not replaced, rerun, rescored or used as a comparison column (5 of 73 cases, Ollama 0.40.6, aborted by the pod replacement)

not_columns: the dev-c7 Haiku and Astra runs (different models; the runtime and day confounds are named for any cross-model reading)

tables: 1 run (runtime 0.40.7 and image, the GPU-fit outcome at the warm-up and at every detected reload, the first measured response)
2 gates guarded (r2 vs dev-c6 qwen vs dev-c5 qwen)
7 context and failures (subsets a and b)
8 uncalled available checks at the decision prefix (unchanged counter, next to dev-c6 qwen)
9 change in words (vs dev-c6 qwen and dev-c5 qwen, confounds named)
tables_note: the dev-c7 section 7 tables for the qwen run: 1 to 10, 12 and 13; table 11 (benchmark passability) was registered for the Astra control only and is not computed here
passability: scripts/passability_v3.py (policy passability-3) stays pinned and unchanged; dev-c7 applied it to the Astra control only, so it is not applied to this qwen pass
uncalled_counter: experimental/contract_v3/uncalled.py summarise(), unchanged, over the run records (table 8), as in dev-c7
confounds: Ollama runtime 0.40.7 vs 0.40.6 (dev-c6, dev-c5, the partial dev-c7 qwen run); the dev-c7 Haiku and Astra runs use no Ollama but differ in day and serving state
prompt v7 vs v6 (dev-c6) and v5 (dev-c5)
format v3.1-format and tools v3 vs v3 / v2 (dev-c6) and v2 (dev-c5)
audit typing (excerpt reading, heads withheld); dev-c5 also decision schema and audit v2
model-visible case alias (derived from the run id; differs in every run)
